speed_ratio_definition: median of complete Cantera warm sequence times / median of complete Julia warm sequence times
scope: All published free, burner and prescribed-temperature transport stages. Includes flame construction, initialization, continuation, adaptive solves; excludes mechanism/sidecar preparation, output snapshots and serialization.
timing_policy: One first measured sequence and nine warm complete sequences per implementation/case/host. First-stage timing excludes startup/imports and some specialization; it is not whole-process cold latency. All samples retained.

wsl.physical_gate_application: Last repetition of every source stage checked against refined references; strict numerical replay establishes the same outputs for all first/warm repetitions.

accuracy.reference: First-order CT extrapolation from controlled whole-grid bisection, with last-extrapolation change retained.
